about: Values that are this mashup's own design (Rust keeps the equivalents as server settings in code, not readable data).

rows.why: Rust charges upkeep continuously over a day (server convars); matches here last hours, so a share is due every 60 min
first Covenant raid 10 min after a beacon is placed
Rust building grid; Forge pieces (6 m) scaled 0.5

rows.value: titanium node 1000 items.stone; alloy node 500 items.metal_ore; plasma node 500 items.sulfur_ore

our own: Rust gets these from animals and hemp, which aren't in Halo

time before a dead Spartan can respawn
